receive.lead: These addresses receive the coin, YEC.

types.name: Transparent, ECC
types.summary: A traditional P2PKH address. A payment to it is visible on chain. Use it where a shielded address cannot go.

deprecated.why: Zcash replaced getnewaddress with unified-address accounts. Ycash still answers it, unless the node is started with -allowdeprecated=none, so software built against the older API keeps working. The address is the same transparent type. The first argument, if you pass one, must be the empty string.

types.name: Sapling
types.summary: A shielded Sapling address. Ask for the sapling receiver on its own. Sprout addresses are refused once Canopy is active.

deprecated.why: Zcash replaced z_getnewaddress with the same unified-address accounts. With no argument it happens to return a Sapling address, and the node says not to rely on that. Ycash still answers it unless -allowdeprecated=none.

types.name: Post-quantum
types.summary: Receives plain YEC at a 53-character address: sq… on mainnet, tq… on testnet, rq… on regtest. sendtoaddress and sendmany spend it. No z_* call pays or spends it. The vault upgrade must be active at the next block, and the wallet must be unlocked.

use.note: "pq" is FN-DSA-512 once Falcon is active at the next block, and SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s before that. "pqslh" is always SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s. Unified addresses have no post-quantum receiver, so this is the supported call even though getnewaddress is on the deprecated-RPC list. The first argument is the empty string.

receive.lead: These addresses hold YED. Yellowback is the system; YED is the unit. The node must have the vault upgrade and a YED attestor set configured.

types.name: Default holder
types.summary: Follows the holder policy: a transparent P2PKH address until Falcon is active, then a post-quantum FN-DSA-512 address.

types.name: Transparent, ECC
types.summary: A P2PKH holder key from the wallet keypool, recorded in the address book. Use it when the holder has to be a traditional ECC key.

types.name: Post-quantum
types.summary: A 53-character post-quantum holder key. FN-DSA-512 once Falcon is active, SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s before that.

use.note: The second argument is an address-book label. It is stored with the address in wallet.dat.

otherKeys.name: Vault owner
otherKeys.summary: The post-quantum key that owns a vault. It is not an address for receiving YEC or YED. Pass the result to vault_lock, or leave the owner out and vault_lock draws one itself.

use.note: Scheme 1, the default, is SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s. Scheme 2 is FN-DSA-512, and only once Falcon is active. yed_getnewaddress "pqowner" derives the same kind of key and does not put it in the address book.

sections.title: Vault primitive
sections.intro: The vault network upgrade's lock/unlock primitive: attestor sets (set_*) and vaults (vault_*). Active from the Vault upgrade, consensus branch ID 6d5b7a31.

sections.title: Yellowback (YED)
sections.intro: Ycash Yellowback (YED), the rule module on the vault primitive: minting, sending and redeeming YED, price attestation and the Yellowback index. Registered on nodes with the vault upgrade and a YED attestor set configured.
